testsuite.name: com.pizzora.backend.Phase18SecurityHardeningTest

testcase.name: security headers include hardening directives and HSTS strictly in production
production environment guard rejects default or weak secrets and allows hardened config
brute-force rate limiting returns 429 with Retry-After while health probes remain unthrottled
body size limits reject oversized Content-Length and chunked payloads with 413
JWT tampering, alg-none, expired tokens, refresh reuse, reset replay, and session revocation are blocked
cross-user IDOR, RBAC, invalid payment signatures, webhook replay, path traversal, and malformed uploads are blocked and logged
